label: Hattush

A.name: Hattush
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:4)
family: descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Hattush
family: descendant-of david (David, son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3))

why: חַטּוּשׁ appears among the covenant signatories, matching A’s stated identification as the Aaronic priest named in Nehemiah 10:4. B is a Judahite descendant of David associated with Ezra’s return, rather than this priestly list.
